articles.title: Rays get help from bottom of order as they move to verge of playoffs
articles.description: After beating the Braves again, a clinch could come as early as Thursday evening, though it would require some assistance.

articles.title: History-making turn on tap for Junior Caminero with next homer
articles.description: Notes | Back-to-back seasons of at least 40 home runs at a young age will put the 23-year-old in elite company.

articles.title: Rays’ Freddy Peralta delivers again in win over NL East-leading Braves
articles.description: That’s three six-inning starts in a row from the right-hander acquired at the trade deadline. He gets plenty of offensive support Tuesday.

articles.title: Rays lose another key player as Taylor Walls goes on IL with hip issue
articles.description: Notes | The shortstop has been playing his usual smooth defense and has been a big part of the small-ball offense.

articles.title: Rays excited to end 2-year absence from playoffs that’s ‘been too long’
articles.description: Sometime in the next few days, bottles will be popping for the first time since 2023, with some lessons learned.

articles.title: Rays’ Freddy Peralta has his groove back, ready to take on Braves
articles.description: Notes | After back-to-back strong six-inning starts, the trade deadline pickup says he has everything in order to continue his success.

articles.title: For Rays’ Chandler Simpson, playing at home in Atlanta means ‘a lot’
articles.description: As his father, Ralph, said of the series against the Braves this week at Truist Park: “This is the dream come true, Part 2.”

articles.title: Rays’ Ty Johnson relieved after making memorable major-league debut
articles.description: Notes | “I worked my whole life for this moment,” says the reliever, who takes over in the seventh inning of a key September game.

articles.title: Rays squander early lead for split with Texas that’s ‘not good enough’
articles.description: Losing a four-run lead, going through five relievers and failing to find a way to get back ahead makes for a frustrating day.

articles.title: So far, Rays’ trade-deadline acquisitions have worked out quite well
articles.description: Tales | Manager Kevin Cash says he “couldn’t be happier” with the additions of Freddy Peralta, Liam Hicks and Tyler Wells.

articles.title: After Rays lose lead, Aranda shows Texas what’s right with homer in 10th
articles.description: A three-run homer off All-Star lefty Jacob Latz after Yandy Diaz is intentionally walked is personal and rewarding for the first baseman.

articles.title: Rays place Garrett Cleavinger on IL, call up Ty Johnson to join bullpen
articles.description: Notes | The lefty reliever says he hasn’t felt like himself and hopes the time off helps. The rookie right-hander is truly just happy to be here.

articles.title: What Chandler Simpson does for Rays isn’t easy, but he keeps doing it
articles.description: An old-school approach of making contact and putting the ball in play has worked really well for the outfielder in his first full season in the majors.

articles.title: Rays end 10-game losing streak at Rangers’ stadium, but it isn’t easy
articles.description: What had seemed a safe lead is reduced to one run in the seventh, but Tampa Bay hangs on for its first win at Globe Life Field since June 2, 2022.

articles.title: Rays place Shane McClanahan on injured list with forearm tightness
articles.description: Notes | The left-hander says his initial sense is that it is not a serious issue and he will be able to pitch again this season.

articles.title: Rays have quiet night in another loss at Texas, see East lead shrink to 3
articles.description: That’s three losses in the last four games at a time when Tampa Bay is looking to secure a playoff berth and build momentum for October.

articles.title: Texas visit is a return to where it all began for Nick Martinez
articles.description: Notes | The veteran pitcher says his formative years in the Rangers organization taught him much about the game.

articles.title: Rays’ Wander Franco headed back to court to appeal latest guilty verdict
articles.description: The one-time All-Star has twice been found guilty of sexual abuse of a minor stemming from a relationship that started when he was 21.

articles.title: Griffin Jax roughed up in return from IL, Rays lose to last-place Mets
articles.description: The veteran right-hander allows six runs and doesn’t get out of the third inning in his first start since an early-August elbow issue.

articles.title: Rays will roll with a six-man rotation for now, but that could change
articles.description: With Griffin Jax returning to the mound, the plan is to “stay in turn” through Tuesday’s game in Atlanta.
